note: File Download provides two field formatters: file_download_formatter (file+image) which renders a forced-download link (Content-Disposition: attachment) via the route /file-download/download/{scheme}/{fid}, and file_download_uri_formatter which renders the download URL. link_title options: file|entity_title|description|empty|custom (+ custom_title_text, token-aware) plus file_size. Permission: access file download. No global settings page (configure=null) — everything is per-field on Manage display (entity_view_display config). Medium cases set a known file_download_formatter component (with custom text) on a real file field and the agent introspects the live view display. Hard cases give a file field displayed with a non-file_download formatter and require switching it to file_download_formatter / file_download_uri_formatter with specific settings, verified against the saved entity_view_display.

evals.prompt: I want a file field on my Drupal Article to render as a link that downloads the file instead of opening it in the browser. Which field formatter from the file_download module do I choose, and what field types does it support?
evals.expected_output: Use the 'File Download' formatter, machine name file_download_formatter, on the field's Manage display. It supports file and image field types and renders a forced-download link (Content-Disposition: attachment).

evals.prompt: In the file_download module's download formatter, what can I use as the link text, and how do I show the file size next to it?
evals.expected_output: The link_title setting can be file (filename), entity_title (parent title), description, empty (icon only), or custom (custom_title_text, which is token-aware). Enable the file_size checkbox to append the human-readable file size.

evals.prompt: How does the file_download module actually force the browser to download the file, and what permission controls access to downloading?
evals.expected_output: The formatter links to the route /file-download/download/{scheme}/{fid}; its controller streams the file with a Content-Disposition: attachment header (plus MIME/length), forcing a download. The 'access file download' permission gates who can download, and core hook_file_download access is still honoured for private files.

evals.prompt: On this site the Article content type has a file field field_fd_known whose default display is configured with the file_download module. Inspect the live view display and give the machine name of the formatter applied to that field.
evals.expected_output: In core.entity_view_display.node.article.default the field_fd_known component uses formatter type file_download_formatter.

evals.prompt: The Article file field field_fd_known on this site uses the file_download formatter with a custom link label. Inspect the running site and report the exact custom link text that is configured.
evals.expected_output: The formatter settings have link_title: custom and custom_title_text: 'Grab it now' on the field_fd_known component of core.entity_view_display.node.article.default.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site the Article content type has a file field field_fd_task that currently displays with the generic file formatter. Using the file_download module, change the default view display so this field renders as a forced-download link AND shows the file size. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: In core.entity_view_display.node.article.default set the field_fd_task component to type file_download_formatter with settings.file_size = true, and save. Verify checks the component type is file_download_formatter and file_size is true.

evals.prompt: My Article file field field_fd_uri should output the file's full download web address (including the domain) so I can reuse it elsewhere, using the file_download module. Please set up the display for that field and save it.
evals.expected_output: In core.entity_view_display.node.article.default set the field_fd_uri component to type file_download_uri_formatter with settings.absolute_url = true, and save. Verify checks the component type is file_download_uri_formatter and absolute_url is true.
